title: Arrival.
logline: The quokka reaches the island and learns to catch a thought before it blows away.

story.setup: At dawn the quokka steps off the ferry; thoughts drift past on the sea wind like loose pages.
story.turn: It presses ⌥C: the first thought (Trip ideas) lands safely in its satchel, Captures.
story.payoff: At the hut, ⌥Space opens a calm window where every caught thought waits to be filed later.

features.claim: Quick capture with ⌥C from anywhere; the thought lands in Captures and gets filed later.
